title: Reader
description: The feeds you follow, in one list, what you read marked
howto: Its feeds are the addresses in feeds.json beside it; a post read is kept in the read collection, by its id.

state.posts: Each feed's newest posts, newest first: id, feed, title, link, date (ISO), and a line of its text.
state.read: A collection of filament.db: the posts marked read, each by the post's id.
